lines.text: The stars are lined up for you today. I checked. Twice.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [whispers] The stars are lined up for you today. I checked. Twice.

lines.text: Mercury's outta retrograde. Finally. Now nobody can touch you.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [suspicious] Mercury's outta retrograde. Finally. Now nobody can touch you.

lines.text: Full moon tonight. Ohhh, that's your moon, baby!
lines.elevenlabs_text: Full moon tonight. [excited] Ohhh, that's your moon, baby!

lines.text: Some people got luck. You? You got the whole Zodiac workin' for ya.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [sarcastic] Some people got luck. You? You got the whole Zodiac workin' for ya.

lines.text: I don't trust nobody, but I trust your chart. That chart's clean.
lines.elevenlabs_text: I don't trust nobody, but I trust your chart. That chart's clean.

lines.text: Venus is in your corner. Don't ask me how I know. I know.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [whispers] Venus is in your corner. Don't ask me how I know. I know.

lines.text: Bad luck? Not this week. The planets owe you one.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [scoffs] Bad luck? Not this week. The planets owe you one.

lines.text: The stars been around a long time, kid. And they're smilin' on you.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [slowly] The stars been around a long time, kid. And they're smilin' on you.

lines.text: Your sun sign says leader. I coulda told ya that myself.
lines.elevenlabs_text: Your sun sign says leader. I coulda told ya that myself.

lines.text: When Jupiter moves, good things follow. And Jupiter's movin'.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [warmly] When Jupiter moves, good things follow. And Jupiter's movin'.

lines.text: I seen a lotta charts in my day. Yours? Yours is somethin'.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [sighs] I seen a lotta charts in my day. Yours? Yours is somethin'.

lines.text: Saturn tests ya. You passed. Now you collect.
lines.elevenlabs_text: Saturn tests ya. You passed. Now you collect.

lines.text: The heavens don't make mistakes. And they made you.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [chuckles] The heavens don't make mistakes. And they made you.

lines.text: Mars is fired up, and so are you! Let's go!
lines.elevenlabs_text: [excited] Mars is fired up, and so are you! Let's go!

lines.text: New moon, new start! Whatever you want, go get it!
lines.elevenlabs_text: [fast] New moon, new start! Whatever you want, go get it!

lines.text: Who says the universe ain't on your side? Bring 'em to me!
lines.elevenlabs_text: [shouting] Who says the universe ain't on your side? Bring 'em to me!

lines.text: The stars said today's your day. Don't make me argue with the stars.
lines.elevenlabs_text: The stars said today's your day. Don't make me argue with the stars.

lines.text: Eclipse season and you're still shinin'? Madonna!
lines.elevenlabs_text: [laughs] Eclipse season and you're still shinin'? Madonna!

lines.text: Venus is lookin' at you, sweetheart. Can't blame her.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [warmly] Venus is lookin' at you, sweetheart. Can't blame her.

lines.text: The moon's in your sign tonight. Take it slow. Enjoy it.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [softly] The moon's in your sign tonight. Take it slow. Enjoy it.

lines.text: Your rising sign? Gorgeous. Just like the rest of ya.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [mischievously] Your rising sign? Gorgeous. Just like the rest of ya.

lines.text: Even the constellations are takin' notes on you.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [chuckles] Even the constellations are takin' notes on you.

lines.text: Relax. The cosmos got a plan for you, and it's a good one.
lines.elevenlabs_text: Relax. The cosmos got a plan for you, and it's a good one.

lines.text: You're made of stardust, you know that? The good kind.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [softly] You're made of stardust, you know that? The good kind.

lines.text: Whatever's written up there for you... it's written in gold.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [slowly] Whatever's written up there for you... it's written in gold.
